sentences: An affine linear loop repeatedly updates an integer vector by a matrix transformation and translation while a conjunction of linear inequalities holds.
Universal integer termination asks whether every integer initial vector eventually leaves the guard.
The 2015 survey's generalization target removes the assumption that the update matrix is diagonalizable.
Its existing results exploit spectral and arithmetic structure in the diagonalizable case, while repeated eigenvalue blocks introduce additional polynomial factors into the trajectories.
Understanding the general case would connect the algebra of linear updates with a complete termination analysis over discrete initial states, rather than real or rational starting spaces.
